PipelineStage.description:
A stage a document can have been through, in pipeline order.

Attributes:
    INGESTED: The upload landed as one or more fragments.
    CLASSIFIED: A classify pass ran over the vault after it landed.
    PRAXIS_SCANNED: The praxis passes ran (inside classify): the keyword
        verdict, then the ``04-Praxis`` page post-pass.
    LINKED_EMBEDDINGS: The ``embeddings`` linker stage ran after it landed.
    LINKED_TEMPORAL: The ``temporal`` linker stage ran after it landed.
    LINKED_EDDIES: The ``eddies`` linker stage ran after it landed.
    LINKED_THREADS: The ``threads`` linker stage ran after it landed.
PipelineStage.title: PipelineStage

description:
How many of the caller's documents one stage has reached (#2147).

The three counts are disjoint: each document is counted at most once per
stage, under the outcome its own ``stages`` row would carry. What is left
of :attr:`PipelineTotals.documents` after all three is the number the
stage has not run over yet.

Attributes:
    stage: Which stage.
    covered: Documents a pass of this stage ran over and finished ``ok``.
        For ``ingested`` this is every document.
    partial: Documents whose covering pass finished ``partial``.
    failed: Documents whose only covering passes ``failed``.

covered.description: Documents the stage covered with outcome ok.
covered.title: Covered

failed.description: Documents whose covering passes all failed.
failed.title: Failed

partial.description: Documents whose covering pass ended partial.
partial.title: Partial

title: PipelineStageTotal
